overview.zh: Motor Channels 按 M 索引发送绝对位置，并独立维护 active motor mask。不要把发送成功提示当成反馈到位；unknown 多圈状态、P4 准入和实际反馈是不同阶段。
overview.en: Motor Channels sends absolute position by M index and maintains an independent active motor mask. Do not treat a send-status message as arrival; multi-turn trust, P4 admission, and physical feedback are distinct stages.

zh.plain: Motor Channels 按电机通道直接设置/发送 ABS 位置，并可独立勾选活动电机范围。该模式面向 M 通道，不先经过 Joint Channels 的关节角反馈目标映射。
zh.condition: 发送按钮要求 controller ready；电机范围选择受 `_scope_update_guard` 与 motor index 有效性约束。多圈 unknown 检查影响发送辅助逻辑/状态提示。
zh.effect: 单行命令读取 slider 对应的 ABS 值，走 `_send_single_motor_abs_from_ui`；选择变化则改 motor mask 并应用 scope。
zh.failure: 控制器未就绪则不发送；ABS 不可用时不标记运行；多圈位置不可信时不得把该状态误读为普通目标。P4 安全策略仍可拒绝命令。
zh.recovery: 确认所选电机在线、路由有效且多圈状态可信；观察 P4 返回状态和安全事件后再继续。
zh.difference: 这里直接控制电机 ABS 计数；Joint Channels 用关节目标和关节 mask，Device Check 用原始 encoder endpoints。
zh.unknown: UI 入参和 mask 不证明绝对位置正确或机械方向安全；须结合校准、多圈恢复及电机映射。
zh.change: 基线未标记此控制流程或 scope 处理为本次变更。

en.plain: Motor Channels directly sets/sends ABS positions by motor channel and can independently select the active motor scope. It operates on M channels rather than first mapping a Joint Channels feedback-angle target.
en.condition: Sending requires controller readiness; motor-scope changes are guarded by `_scope_update_guard` and motor-index validity. The multi-turn-unknown check affects send support/status handling.
en.effect: A row command reads the slider’s ABS value and calls `_send_single_motor_abs_from_ui`; selection changes update the motor mask and apply the scope.
en.failure: Not-ready blocks sending; unavailable ABS does not mark the row running. An untrusted multi-turn position must not be treated as an ordinary target. P4 safety rules may still reject a command.
en.recovery: Confirm the selected motor is online, routed, and has trusted multi-turn state; inspect P4 status/safety events before continuing.
en.difference: This sends motor ABS counts; Joint Channels uses joint targets/masks, while Device Check edits raw encoder endpoints.
en.unknown: UI input and masks do not prove the absolute position or direction is mechanically safe; verify calibration, multi-turn recovery, and motor mapping.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this control or scope path as changed.

zh.plain: `send_motor_row(idx)` 读取并同步 M 行 slider 的 ABS 目标，然后发送该单电机绝对命令。发送成功后标记行状态、清除已发送目标，只有活动 scope 的多圈 unknown mask 为零时才显示“absolute command sent”。
zh.condition: 顺序条件为 `not self._controller_interaction_ready()`、`sent_abs is not None` 和 `self._active_scope_multiturn_unknown_mask() == 0`；第三个条件控制成功状态提示，不是 `sent_abs` 调用的前置门。
zh.effect: 调用 `_mark_motor_target_user_set`、`_sync_motor_abs_from_slider_before_send` 和 `_send_single_motor_abs_from_ui`；返回的 `sent_abs` 非 None 后更新行状态并清理该行目标。
zh.failure: 控制器不就绪则立即返回；发送 helper 返回 None 时不执行成功后处理；unknown mask 非零时不会显示最终成功状态。
zh.recovery: 确认控制器交互就绪、ABS 值有效且范围内电机多圈已知；若无成功提示，查发送 helper/安全事件而非重复盲发。
zh.difference: 一条 M 通道 ABS 指令，与 joint mode 的角度/反馈命令不同；unknown 检查在这里还用于状态/辅助清理判断。
zh.unknown: 底层命令 ACK、ABS 单位、发送 helper 的拒绝细节未在本函数片段完全展开。
zh.change: 基线未标记此控制流程或 scope 处理为本次变更。

en.plain: `send_motor_row(idx)` synchronizes the M-row slider’s ABS target and sends a single-motor absolute command. On success it marks the row, clears the sent target, and shows “absolute command sent” only if the active scope’s multi-turn-unknown mask is zero.
en.condition: The conditions are `not self._controller_interaction_ready()`, `sent_abs is not None`, and `self._active_scope_multiturn_unknown_mask() == 0`. The third condition gates the success status, not the call that produces `sent_abs`.
en.effect: Calls `_mark_motor_target_user_set`, `_sync_motor_abs_from_slider_before_send`, and `_send_single_motor_abs_from_ui`. A non-None `sent_abs` updates row state and clears the row target.
en.failure: Not-ready returns immediately; a None result skips success handling; a nonzero unknown mask suppresses the final success status.
en.recovery: Confirm interaction readiness, a valid ABS value, and known multi-turn state for motors in scope. If no success status appears, inspect the send helper and safety events instead of blindly resending.
en.difference: This is one M-channel ABS command, unlike joint-mode angle/feedback commands; the unknown check also affects status/cleanup handling here.
en.unknown: ACK behavior, ABS units, and all send-helper rejection details are not fully shown in this function excerpt.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this control or scope path as changed.

zh.plain: 该检查在电机目标发送前确认 UI 当前可与控制器交互。
zh.condition: `not self._controller_interaction_ready()` 为真时 controller 不 ready；为假才继续标记目标并生成 ABS 命令。
zh.effect: 真时立即返回；假时调用 send helper。
zh.failure: 条件为真时控制器未就绪，函数直接返回；为假时继续同步 slider 并尝试发送 ABS 目标。
zh.recovery: 检查 P4 连接、当前模式和状态栏/拒绝事件后再点 Run。
zh.difference: 全局交互门控，区别于 motor channel validity 和 multi-turn 检查。
zh.unknown: 具体 readiness 谓词未在本包列出。
zh.change: 基线未标记此控制流程或 scope 处理为本次变更。

en.plain: The pre-send guard asks whether the controller permits UI interaction.
en.condition: True for `not self._controller_interaction_ready()` means the controller is not ready; false allows target marking and ABS command construction.
en.effect: True returns immediately; false invokes the send helper.
en.failure: When true the controller is not ready and the function returns; when false it synchronizes the slider and attempts to send the ABS target.
en.recovery: Check P4 connection, current mode, status bar, and rejection events before pressing Run again.
en.difference: This is a global interaction gate, distinct from motor-index validity and multi-turn checks.
en.unknown: The exact readiness predicate is not included in this packet.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this control or scope path as changed.

zh.plain: `sent_abs` 表示单电机 ABS send helper 是否返回了可确认的发送值。
zh.condition: `sent_abs is not None` 为真表示 helper 给出具体 sent value；为假表示没有可确认发送结果。
zh.effect: 真时设置 running 状态并清掉刚发出的 slider 目标；假时跳过这两步，后续也不宣告成功发送。
zh.failure: 条件为真时 helper 返回了 ABS 目标，行状态和目标缓存会更新；为假时不执行成功后的行更新。
zh.recovery: 针对 helper 返回原因检查数值、模式、设备状态后重新操作。
zh.difference: 它验证发送结果是否可用，不检查请求 slider 的 UI 显示本身。
zh.unknown: 成功 ACK 与物理电机执行完成仍需后续反馈证据。
zh.change: 基线未标记此控制流程或 scope 处理为本次变更。

en.plain: `sent_abs` indicates whether the single-motor ABS send helper returned a confirmable sent value.
en.condition: True for `sent_abs is not None` means the helper returned a concrete value; false means there is no confirmable send result.
en.effect: True marks the row running and clears the just-sent slider target; false skips both steps and does not announce a successful send.
en.failure: When true the helper returned an ABS target and row/target state is updated; when false the success-path row update is skipped.
en.recovery: Use the helper’s refusal reason to check value, mode, and device state before retrying.
en.difference: This validates whether the send result is usable, not the slider’s displayed request itself.
en.unknown: A successful helper result still needs later feedback to prove physical execution.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this control or scope path as changed.

zh.plain: 此判断读取活动电机范围内是否仍有 unknown multi-turn position。
zh.condition: `self._active_scope_multiturn_unknown_mask() == 0` 为真表示 active scope 全部多圈位置可信；非零表示至少一台仍未知。
zh.effect: 为真时显示 ABS 命令发送状态；为假时不显示该成功状态，以免掩盖位置可信问题。
zh.failure: 条件为真时 scope 内没有未知多圈位置，状态可显示命令已发送；为假时不能确认绝对位置安全，成功状态不显示。
zh.recovery: 完成 JSON nearest-turn recovery；仍未知时检查对应电机并做关节标定。
zh.difference: 该条件位于发送返回后的 UI 状态更新处，和命令是否进入底层的 helper 判断区分开。
zh.unknown: 更深层 helper 是否同样拒绝命令需阅读其实现；本片段仅证明状态提示条件。
zh.change: 基线未标记此控制流程或 scope 处理为本次变更。

en.plain: This check asks whether any motor in the active scope still has an unknown multi-turn position.
en.condition: True for `self._active_scope_multiturn_unknown_mask() == 0` means all scoped multi-turn positions are trusted; nonzero means at least one is unknown.
en.effect: True shows the ABS-command-sent status. False suppresses that success status so the untrusted-position issue is not hidden.
en.failure: When true no unknown multi-turn position remains in scope and sent status can be shown; when false absolute-position safety is unconfirmed and success status is withheld.
en.recovery: Complete JSON nearest-turn recovery; if still unknown, inspect the affected motor and recalibrate its joint.
en.difference: This check occurs in post-send UI status handling; it is distinct from any helper gate that determines whether a command enters the lower layer.
en.unknown: Whether the lower send helper also refuses the command requires its implementation; this excerpt proves only the status condition.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this control or scope path as changed.

zh.plain: `_on_motor_use_changed(motor_idx, checked)` 响应电机通道勾选。忽略程序同步信号，仅在 `_motor_channel_valid` 时设置/清除 selected motor mask，然后同步分组勾选、应用当前模式活动范围并刷新按钮。
zh.condition: 原始条件 `bool(getattr(self, "_scope_update_guard", False))` 为真时忽略程序同步；否则由 `_motor_channel_valid(int(motor_idx))` 校验通道，并依据 `checked` 设置或清除 mask bit。
zh.failure: 无效 motor index 不改 mask；同步 guard 为真时整个回调返回。它没有直接发送 ABS 命令。
zh.recovery: 选中有效在线通道后检查当前活动 scope 与 P4 显示；需要动作时再单独用 Run M 行发送。
zh.difference: 这是范围勾选，不是 Motor Channels 的电机运动命令；与 joint checkbox 的 joint→motor 映射不同。
zh.unknown: 应用 scope 的具体 P4 命令及设备接受结果未在这段回调中展示。
zh.change: 基线未标记此控制流程或 scope 处理为本次变更。

en.plain: `_on_motor_use_changed(motor_idx, checked)` handles a motor-channel checkbox. It ignores programmatic sync signals, changes the selected-motor mask only for a valid M index, then syncs group checks, applies the current-mode scope, and refreshes buttons.
en.condition: Raw condition `bool(getattr(self, "_scope_update_guard", False))` true ignores programmatic sync; otherwise `_motor_channel_valid(int(motor_idx))` validates the channel and `checked` sets or clears its mask bit.
en.effect: Updates the `_selected_motor_mask` bit, then calls `_sync_scope_group_checks`, `_apply_active_scope_for_current_mode`, and `_update_manual_action_buttons`.
en.failure: An invalid motor index leaves the mask unchanged; a true sync guard returns from the whole callback. It does not send an ABS command.
en.recovery: Select a valid online channel and inspect the active scope/P4 display. Use Run M separately when a motion command is intended.
en.difference: This changes scope, not motor motion; unlike joint selection it does not derive motor selection from a joint mask.
en.unknown: The actual P4 scope command and device acceptance are not shown in this callback.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this control or scope path as changed.

zh.plain: 该守卫忽略由代码同步触发的 checkbox 改变。
zh.condition: `bool(getattr(self, "_scope_update_guard", False))` 为真表示程序正在更新控件；为假才处理用户输入。
zh.effect: 真时返回避免组勾选/电机勾选重复触发；假时继续验证 motor index。
zh.failure: 条件为真时忽略程序内部的 checkbox 回写；为假时继续处理用户对 motor 范围的勾选。
zh.recovery: 同步完成后用户操作按正常路径更新；若一直返回，检查同步保护释放。
zh.difference: 它只管理 UI 信号，不代表控制器 busy 或 motor online。
zh.unknown: `finally` 清理保护状态的实现位于同步函数代码中。
zh.change: 基线未标记此控制流程或 scope 处理为本次变更。

en.plain: This guard ignores checkbox changes caused by programmatic synchronization.
en.condition: True for `bool(getattr(self, "_scope_update_guard", False))` means code is updating controls; false means process the user input.
en.effect: True returns to avoid group/motor checkboxes triggering each other recursively; false proceeds to validate the motor index.
en.failure: When true the callback ignores an internal checkbox write; when false it processes the user’s motor-scope change.
en.recovery: User changes follow the normal path after synchronization completes; if the callback always returns, inspect guard release.
en.difference: This manages UI signals, not controller busy state or motor-online status.
en.unknown: The synchronization code releases the flag in `finally`.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this control or scope path as changed.

zh.plain: 此条件验证事件提供的 M 索引属于系统有效电机通道。
zh.condition: `_motor_channel_valid(int(motor_idx))` 为真才设置或清除对应 bit；假时保留原 mask。
zh.effect: 有效索引按 checked 状态设置/清除 `_selected_motor_mask`；之后仍同步 group checks 和 active scope。
zh.failure: 条件为真时 motor_idx 是有效通道并可更新 mask；为假时不修改该 motor 的所选位。
zh.recovery: 检查 motor row 到 M 编号的映射，保证控件只产生合法通道索引。
zh.difference: 它验证电机编号，不验证舵机在线、路由和多圈可信性。
zh.unknown: valid helper 的全部边界配置需看硬件 map 定义。
zh.change: 基线未标记此控制流程或 scope 处理为本次变更。

en.plain: Validates the M-channel index carried by the event.
en.condition: True for `_motor_channel_valid(int(motor_idx))` allows setting or clearing its bit; false preserves the current mask.
en.effect: A valid index sets/clears `_selected_motor_mask` according to `checked`; group checks and active scope are synchronized afterward.
en.failure: When true motor_idx is a valid channel and its mask bit can change; when false the selected bit is left untouched.
en.recovery: Check the motor-row-to-M mapping so the widget emits only valid indices.
en.difference: This validates the motor index, not online status, route, or multi-turn trust.
en.unknown: Inspect the hardware-map definition for the full valid-index set.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this control or scope path as changed.

zh.plain: `checked` 是电机 checkbox 的新状态，决定该 motor 是否属于 selected scope。
zh.condition: 原始布尔量 `checked` 表示电机 checkbox 的新状态：为真加入 selected scope，为假清除对应电机 bit。
zh.effect: 真时 OR 入该 motor bit；假时清除 bit。接着同步组勾选并应用活动 scope。
zh.failure: 条件为真时设置该 motor 的 scope 位；为假时清除该位。两者均表示选择编辑，不会直接发送 STOP 或 ABS 命令。
zh.recovery: 要控制该电机，重新选中有效行后再单独执行 Run M；核对 P4 回报范围。
zh.difference: 范围变化和 `send_motor_row` 的绝对位置命令是两个不同动作。
zh.unknown: P4 接受/拒绝范围的协议结果不在 checkbox 回调中体现。
zh.change: 基线未标记此控制流程或 scope 处理为本次变更。

en.plain: `checked` is the motor checkbox’s new state and determines whether that motor belongs to selected scope.
en.condition: Raw boolean `checked` is the motor checkbox’s new state: true adds the motor to selected scope; false clears its bit.
en.effect: True ORs the motor bit into the mask; false clears it. Group checks are then synced and active scope applied.
en.failure: When true the motor’s scope bit is set; when false it is cleared. Both outcomes edit selection and send neither STOP nor an ABS command.
en.recovery: To control it, select a valid row and separately run Run M; confirm the scope reported by P4.
en.difference: Scope change and `send_motor_row` absolute-position command are separate actions.
en.unknown: The checkbox callback does not show the protocol result of P4 accepting/rejecting scope.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this control or scope path as changed.

en.condition: True for `bool(getattr(self, "_scope_update_guard", False))` means code is updating controls; false means process the user input.
en.effect: True returns to avoid group/motor checkboxes triggering each other recursively; false proceeds to validate the motor index.
en.failure: When true the callback ignores an internal checkbox write; when false it processes the user’s motor-scope change.
en.recovery: User changes follow the normal path after synchronization completes; if the callback always returns, inspect guard release.
en.difference: This checks command admission or selection updates; it does not prove that the device executed the request.

en.plain: This predicate edge routes the action to its guard; the detail preserves the expression and explains each branch outcome.
en.condition: True for `_motor_channel_valid(int(motor_idx))` allows setting or clearing its bit; false preserves the current mask.
en.effect: A valid index sets/clears `_selected_motor_mask` according to `checked`; group checks and active scope are synchronized afterward.
en.failure: When true motor_idx is a valid channel and its mask bit can change; when false the selected bit is left untouched.
en.recovery: Check the motor-row-to-M mapping so the widget emits only valid indices.
en.difference: This checks command admission or selection updates; it does not prove that the device executed the request.
en.unknown: Inspect the hardware-map definition for the full valid-index set.

zh.recovery: 要控制该电机，重新选中有效行后再单独执行 Run M；核对 P4 回报范围。

en.plain: This predicate edge routes the action to its guard; the detail preserves the expression and explains each branch outcome.
en.condition: Raw boolean `checked` is the motor checkbox’s new state: true adds the motor to selected scope; false clears its bit.
en.effect: True ORs the motor bit into the mask; false clears it. Group checks are then synced and active scope applied.
en.failure: When true the motor’s scope bit is set; when false it is cleared. Both outcomes edit selection and send neither STOP nor an ABS command.
en.recovery: To control it, select a valid row and separately run Run M; confirm the scope reported by P4.
en.difference: This checks command admission or selection updates; it does not prove that the device executed the request.
en.unknown: The checkbox callback does not show the protocol result of P4 accepting/rejecting scope.
